content: Both neural models outperform the unsupervised baselines by a large margin. When comparing the two models, the attentive reader is able to beat the bilinear model by only INLINEFORM0 . A possible explanation for this is that the attentive reader only attends to the text. Since many questions cannot be directly answered from the text, the attentive reader is not able to perform significantly better than a simpler neural model.
